source.note: Ids, names, rules text, keywords, realms, descend quests and every image come out of the shipped client. tier, cost, attack and health are not present in that build — they were carried in from an earlier dataset, and cost plus the god realms were checked against the running game on 1.5.7. Gods carry no Tier in any source; they are set to 6, the top Sanctum Tier, by hand.

excluded.name: Awakening Pill
excluded.reason: In the client's localization tables but not obtainable in game on 1.5.7. Extracting a build will produce it again — drop it again unless the game has since added it.

conventions.textPlaceholders: Rules text keeps {0}-style placeholders on purpose. Those numbers are not fixed — cards in play change what a Medicine is worth, so the game computes the value at runtime. Render the placeholder, do not try to fill it in.
conventions.medicineCost: Medicine spells have no cost. They are not bought with gold; Alchemy grants them, so a null cost on a medicine card is the right answer rather than a missing one.
conventions.godCost: Gods have no cost — a patron is chosen, not bought.
